title: chamaecrista glandulosa var. pinetorum
intro: Chamaecrista glandulosa var. pinetorum, commonly known as Pineland Partridge pea, is a flowering plant species belonging to the legume family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Pineland Partridge pea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
